title: FLATTERY IN MOTION: BENCHMARKING AND ANALYZING SYCOPHANCY IN VIDEO-LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to misleading, suggestive, or doubtful user prompts using a specialized video question-answering benchmark (ViSE) to measure the Misleading Susceptibility Score (MSS), which quantifies the model's propensity to erroneously agree with factually incorrect user input.
